title: Goodword × Startups Decoded: NYC Fireside with Eric Ries
summary: Goodword (Caroline Dell) partners with Startups Decoded (Andy Walsh) to host an intimate New York fireside with Eric on May 22 — billed as a deep dive on Incorruptible's structural argument.
blockquote:
Most founders don't set out to compromise their values.

They just don't build systems to protect them.

That's the argument at the center of Eric Ries' new book, Incorruptible.

Not that companies go bad because of bad people. But that success itself creates structural forces that pull even principled leaders off course.
